central_finding: All fifteen binder IR have empty inputs. Their function identity/argument forwarding exists as metadata or edge prose instead of actual argument relationships. The missing generic parameter-binding primitive is not evidence that these source functions require a new primitive: existing typed CFG operands and source-backed call-boundary summaries can represent the real values. Processing is right not to invent input(0) for these frozen instructions; the larger cross-stage representation is defective.

independent_root_caveat.detail: block_029 has no predecessors but must not be called unreachable: the solver seeds all predecessor-free blocks as independent roots. Its problem is absence of a caller data relation, not automatic exclusion from the worklist.

read_location_caveat: A read operation is available but must have a genuine source-backed runtime/storage location and version. It is not a universal substitute for caller parameters. In particular later saveResult payloads are produced report/aggregate versions; rereading root invocation arguments would change their source identity.
interface_scope: A generic interprocedural call-frame/return-stack execution engine is not represented here. That expressiveness boundary is real, but these finite source-backed functions do not by themselves require such an engine; repair the CFG or summarize at real call boundaries before labeling parameter binding as inherently unsupported.
